cards.snippet: If this was in rebellion or breach of faith against the LORD, do not spare us today.

cards.card_text: Joshua keeps going: the LORD is a holy God and a jealous God, and He will not forgive their rebellion or their sins.
cards.verse_text: But Joshua said to the people, “You are not able to serve the LORD, for He is a holy God; He is a jealous God; He will not forgive your rebellion or your sins.
cards.snippet: …holy God; He is a jealous God; He will not forgive your rebellion or your sins.

cards.card_text: Paul is clear: "Let no one deceive you in any way…" That Day won't come until the rebellion happens and the man of lawlessness, the son of destruction, is revealed.
cards.verse_text: Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness—the son of destruction—is revealed.
cards.snippet: …deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness—the son of destruction—is revealed.

cards.card_text: The words point back to the rebellion, the day of testing in the wilderness.

cards.card_text: He quotes the Psalm again: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.” Then he starts asking questions, the kind where everybody in the room already knows the answer.
cards.verse_text: As it has been said: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.” For who were the ones who heard and rebelled?
cards.snippet: …His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.” For who were the ones who heard and rebelled?

cards.card_text: Jude says these men have perished in Korah's rebellion.
cards.verse_text: They have traveled the path of Cain; they have rushed for profit into the error of Balaam; they have perished in Korah’s rebellion.
cards.snippet: …for profit into the error of Balaam; they have perished in Korah’s rebellion.
